master_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a finished square app icon for the Vietnamese game Tiệm Bánh Tráng Trộn Nhỏ using the attached image as the design reference. The subject MUST be this traditional Vietnamese shoulder-pole street-food stall: TWO shallow round woven bamboo baskets suspended from ONE curved bamboo carrying pole, with a pink-and-cream striped parasol above the left side. Left basket holds a small metal mixing bowl, rice-paper sheets and three tiny condiment jars; right basket holds green kumquats, yellow shredded mango and two takeaway bags of rice-paper salad. Preserve this stall's recognisable silhouette, props, warm colors, rounded dark-brown outlines and cozy cartoon style. Make the parasol and the two baskets the dominant clear shapes, simplify fine woven texture and tiny ingredient detail for legibility. Keep the central hanging tan sign with exactly these three stacked words: BÁNH / TRÁNG / TRỘN. Do not turn the main subject into a noodle bowl, restaurant storefront, shopping cart or a person. Composition: compact front view of the complete gánh including parasol, both baskets and carrying pole, centered as one balanced icon. Full-bleed opaque warm pale peach-pink background, no street, floor, buildings or scenery. Very important: all foreground including parasol tips and bottom corners of baskets must fit inside an imaginary circle at canvas center with radius 38% of canvas width, so Android can safely mask it; leave clear generous padding on all four sides. This circle must NOT be drawn. No border, no pre-rounded corners, no mockup or icon sheet, no watermark or extra lettering. Deliver ONLY the one square icon artwork.

Change ONLY framing: scale the ENTIRE foreground stall down substantially, so its complete width and complete height fit inside the central 55% of the square canvas, centered. Leave very wide pale peach-pink background padding around it. Every part, especially the left parasol tip and both lower basket corners, must be safely inside a circle of radius 36% of canvas width centered on the canvas. Do not draw that circle. Preserve a seamless peach-pink background filling the full square. Do not add anything, do not crop the stall, do not round corners or add borders. Deliver one square icon.
